verdicts.reason: Both reduce the key building photo to a small, meaningless sliver on the left that runs into the headline's right-aligned lines, so the brand imagery is mostly lost and there's an unwanted collision. A fills the column better with larger type, but it breaks the headline into one word per line, and 'limit' sits almost against the left edge. B's 'is not' line wraps more naturally, but the headline is smaller and surrounded by more empty space above and below, so the canvas looks emptier.
